Feature: Guided flow with no progress loss
Description: A step-by-step process that ensures users do not lose their progress during the reporting process.

Feature: Support for 10 Indian languages via voice input
Description: Users can input information in their preferred Indian language, and the system converts it to English for legal purposes.

Feature: Automatically converts user description to a court-admissible English FIR
Description: The system automatically generates a legal document that can be used in court, citing relevant laws.

Feature: Automatically pre-fills forms with UTR numbers or scam SMS
Description: Users can easily upload screenshots or paste scam SMS, and the system pre-fills the form, reducing the stress of manual entry.
The backend generates a JSON payload that can be used to freeze scammer accounts, turning a complaint into an active intervention.

Feature: Provides a verified PDF docket for police station submission
Description: Users receive a verified PDF docket that can be used as evidence at a police station.
